sloka: सफेना सस्वना भूत्वा सागरस्य समुत्थिताम् ।प्रशान्तमारुतोद्घातां जलोर्मिमिव निस्वनाम् ॥ २.११४.७॥
transliteration: saphenā sasvanā bhūtvā sāgarasya samutthitām ।praśāntamārutodghātāṁ jalormimiva nisvanām ॥ 2.114.7॥

translations.english: It was like an ocean wave that had risen foaming and roaring but, swept by a gentle breeze, had fallen silent.
